prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production tactical fantasy game FX animation frame, spark-spray, 1254 x 1254 genuine transparent RGBA.
Input 1 is the original effect identity and motion-pose reference. Redraw its narrow blue-gray blocking crescent and amber impact sparks in clean chunky outlined cartoon fantasy style. Ignore the magenta background entirely. This effect is a long curved defensive stroke, open on the LEFT, convex on the RIGHT. It is not a solid shield face, not a crescent moon disk, and has no handle, bearer, crest or heraldry. Preserve the very slender curved blue-gray shape with pointed ends, a pale slate highlight band and a darker slate outer face bounded by clean near-black contours. The entire area to its left and around it remains transparent.
Common animation framing: fixed upright view and 1254 square canvas. Crescent upper pointed tip near (340,190), lower tip near (690,1050), maximum rightward bow near x800 around y680. Its tapering solid band is about 55–95 pixels thick around the middle; do not fill its open concave side or make a broad opaque shield. Keep both pointed tips complete and generous transparent margins.
The peak impact is at the same mid-right contact point (about x770,y605) on the crescent's convex contour. A compact sharply outlined amber starburst with a pale-gold core and 6–8 unequal pointed rays projects mostly rightward from this point. Around it, about ten detached tapered amber spark shards form a controlled outward spray, with a long upper-right shard, several shorter rightward/downward shards and a few short fragments left of contact as in the reference. Each has a readable gold face and a slim dark ochre contour. Keep every shard and tip within x250..1100 and y130..1100, with transparent gaps. No circular explosion cloud, smoke, broad glow, glitter dust or lens flare. The crescent remains dominant and its geometry is not bent or translated by the spark spray.
Material/style: broad simple slate-blue facets, strong dark contours and compact gold spark shapes readable at 32 pixels. No fine texture, white halo, matte plate, checkerboard, gradient backdrop, ground, letters or label. Preserve genuine alpha transparency in all exterior and negative space. Output one independently authored phase only, no sprite sheet.
